# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update. The preview updates the bundled renderer and includes the current HarfBuzzSharp binding-generation model.

## Breaking Changes

- **Corrected Unicode combining-class enum name** — UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 is now CCC132, matching the corrected upstream HarfBuzz name while retaining numeric value 132. Update source references to use CCC132.
- **GlyphFlags.Defined is no longer exposed** — The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask was removed because it is not an independent option. Combine the concrete glyph flags required by your application instead.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Aligns the preview line with the Chrome m154 renderer. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 4, 2026)

Preview 1 opens the 4.154 line with the Skia m154 engine update.
